Question: SOQL (data model and soql)
Answer: know the object, want filtered results

Question: SOSL (data model and soql)
Answer: keyword search across multiple objects

Question: sObject (data model and soql)
Answer: the generic type for any Salesforce record, such as an Account or a custom object record.

Question: Master-detail relationship (data model and soql)
Answer: a tight parent-child link where the child inherits sharing from the parent and is deleted with it.

Question: Lookup relationship (data model and soql)
Answer: a loose link between two objects that does not make one depend on the other.

Question: Apex trigger (apex triggers and classes)
Answer: code that runs before or after a record is inserted, updated, deleted or undeleted.

Question: Before trigger (apex triggers and classes)
Answer: a trigger that runs before records are saved, used to validate or change values on the records themselves.

Question: After trigger (apex triggers and classes)
Answer: a trigger that runs after records are saved, used to act on related records or on values set by the system.

Question: Bulkification (apex triggers and classes)
Answer: writing code to handle many records in one run instead of one at a time, to stay within governor limits.

Question: Governor limits (apex triggers and classes)
Answer: runtime limits that Salesforce enforces on Apex so that no one tenant uses too many shared resources.

Question: Future method (async apex and platform events)
Answer: an Apex method marked @future that runs asynchronously when system resources are free.

Question: Queueable Apex (async apex and platform events)
Answer: an asynchronous Apex class that can take complex types as input and be chained to another job.

Question: Batch Apex (async apex and platform events)
Answer: an Apex class that processes large record sets in chunks, each chunk running as its own transaction.

Question: Schedulable Apex (async apex and platform events)
Answer: an Apex class that runs at a set time using the Schedulable interface.

Question: Platform event (async apex and platform events)
Answer: a custom event message used for event-driven communication between Salesforce and external systems.

Question: @api (lwc and visualforce)
Answer: public property; settable from parent or record context

Question: @track (lwc and visualforce)
Answer: reactive (most LWC properties are reactive by default; only need @track for objects/arrays where you want deep reactivity)

Question: @wire (lwc and visualforce)
Answer: declarative data via Apex method or Lightning Data Service
